work.title: Welt- und Lebensanschauungen im neunzehnten Jahrhundert
work.source_summary: Preferred DjVu has only 8/273 pages with a hidden text layer and yields about 11.5k chars, just front matter plus a short excerpt. A larger combined microfilm candidate is tagged for both GA18 and 18a and has visibly damaged OCR/control characters; it is not a clean standalone substitute. No passable GA18a source is established.
